fields.name: name
fields.meaning: What the person and the model call it; the block heads its text with it.

fields.name: description
fields.meaning: One line: what it is for. The model reads it when it may pick the skill, and the Library and the scene show it.

fields.name: text
fields.meaning: The instructions; macros render as in any prompt text.

fields.name: when
fields.meaning: "always": every turn while linked; "mentioned": when its triggers match; "picked": while the model has it open.

fields.name: triggers
fields.meaning: "mentioned": a lorebook entry's primary triggers, matched as a lore entry's are (any one of them).

fields.name: secondaryTriggers
fields.meaning: With the primary ones, combined by `selectiveLogic`, as a lore entry's secondary triggers.

fields.name: selectiveLogic
fields.meaning: How the secondary triggers combine with the primary ones (the lorebook's and_any, and_all, not_any, not_all).

fields.name: caseSensitive
fields.meaning: The triggers match case as written.

fields.name: matchWholeWords
fields.meaning: A plain trigger matches only as a whole word.

fields.name: scanDepth
fields.meaning: How many of the newest messages the triggers read, the one being answered included.

fields.name: closeWhenUnmentioned
fields.meaning: "picked": it also closes on a turn its triggers no longer match.
